detail.longDescription: I'd often make Google searches whose AI overviews would lead me to ask followups and create AI Mode threads. The key problem was that these chats were ephemeral. So I decided to make this extension that can help replay the chats and responses verbatim in your platform of choice (Gemini and Claude for now), so that the chats remain forever. The chats are replayed faithfully so that the new platform has all the context.
